transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I guess… my eating’s been pretty off lately. Some days before work I barely manage coffee and maybe a granola bar, and my scrubs are getting loose. I’m not trying to lose weight or anything.
Have you lost weight recently?
Yeah… I think so. I haven’t been weighing myself much, but my scrubs are looser, and I’m not trying to lose weight. Some mornings I barely get coffee and maybe a granola bar down before work.
Do you ever think about your weight or body shape when you're deciding what or how much to eat?

Not really. It’s not about my weight or how I look. I just… don’t eat much some days, like maybe coffee and a granola bar before work, and my scrubs have been getting loose. I’m not trying to lose weight.
Do you find that you're just not that interested in eating some days?
Yeah… some days I just don’t really want food. I’ll get through with coffee and maybe a granola bar before my shift, and then I realize my scrubs are hanging looser. I’m not doing it on purpose.
How much weight do you think you've lost since this started?
I’m not sure exactly… I haven’t been checking. Just enough that my scrubs are loose now. It wasn’t something I was trying to do.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
Yeah… most mornings I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling. Like the day’s already kind of ruined before I even get my badge on.
Do you think the heavy, hollow feeling you wake up with affects how interested you are in eating?

Yeah… I think so. When I wake up feeling like that, food just doesn’t really appeal to me. I’ll just do coffee and maybe a granola bar before work, and then… I notice my scrubs are looser. It’s not like I’m trying to lose weight.
Do you think you would want to eat more if you weren't feeling so sad and down?

Probably, yeah. If I didn’t wake up feeling so low, I think I’d be more interested in eating. Lately it’s just… coffee, maybe a granola bar before a shift, and that’s about all I can get down some days. My scrubs hanging loose kind of makes it hard to ignore.
Do you ever eat more when you're feeling better emotionally?

Not really more, no. I mean… maybe a little, but lately it’s mostly been the other way. Even on better moments, I’m still kind of just getting by with coffee and a granola bar before work. My scrubs being loose is what made me notice it.
Is there anything else besides your emotional state that you think contributes to your lack of interest in eating some days?

Not that I can really point to. It mostly just feels like my eating’s been off… some days it’s only coffee and a granola bar before my shift. And my scrubs are hanging loose now, so… I guess that’s what got my attention. I’m not trying to lose weight.
Are you ever worried that if you eat more, you might gain weight?

No… not really. I’m not worried about gaining weight. It’s more that I just don’t feel like eating. Some days it’s just coffee and maybe a granola bar before work, and my scrubs are loose now, so… I know I’m not eating enough.
Do you think your lack of interest in eating is always because of your emotional state?

I don’t think it’s always emotional, no. It’s just… my eating’s gotten really off. Some days I barely get down coffee and a granola bar before a shift, and my scrubs are loose now. I’m not trying to lose weight.
Is your lack of interest in eating usually worse on the mornings when you wake up with that heavy, hollow feeling?

Yeah… usually, I think. On those mornings it’s harder to make myself eat much. Sometimes it’s just coffee, maybe a granola bar before my shift. I’ve noticed my scrubs are looser, so… it’s been enough to worry me a little.
Do you think your emotional state is the main reason you're not interested in eating some days?

Yeah… I think it’s a big part of it. Some days I just can’t get interested in food. I’ll get by on coffee and maybe a granola bar before work, and then I notice my scrubs are hanging loose. I’m not trying to lose weight or anything.
Are there any parts of your daily life or routine that have been affected by your eating less?

A little, yeah. Work’s been… harder. I’ve made some dumb mistakes I normally wouldn’t, and I have to ask people to repeat simple things sometimes.

And I’ve been skipping stuff after work, like chess nights or going out for photo walks. I just don’t really trust myself to keep up or seem normal.
Are you finding it harder to enjoy or participate in activities you normally like to do outside of work because of your lack of interest in eating?

Yeah… I guess so. I used to run in Van Cortlandt, take photos, play chess with friends. Lately I mostly just talk myself out of it, like… what’s the point. Then I end up at home scrolling or messing with my budget spreadsheet.
Do you feel like your eating habits are affecting your ability to perform your job or take care of yourself?

Yeah… it is, I think. At work I’ve been making mistakes I should’ve caught, and sometimes I need people to repeat simple stuff, which is embarrassing.

Taking care of myself… I don’t know. I’m managing, but I’ve been avoiding things after work, like chess or going out to take photos, because I don’t really trust myself to keep up or act normal.
Are there other areas of your life, besides work, where you feel your eating habits are causing problems?

Yeah… mostly outside work it’s social stuff, I guess. I’ve been skipping chess nights and those photo walks I used to do.

It’s not just the eating, exactly, but I feel kind of off, and I don’t trust myself to keep up or act normal around people. So I just don’t go.
Do you think you would eat normally if your emotional state improved?

Maybe. I mean… if I felt better, maybe I’d eat more normally.

Right now it’s gotten pretty off. Some days before a shift I barely manage coffee and a granola bar, and my scrubs are hanging loose. I’m not trying to lose weight or anything.
Do you think you would start eating normally again if your sadness and hollow feeling went away?

Yeah… I think so. If that hollow feeling lifted, maybe I’d eat more like I used to.

Right now it’s just gotten pretty off. Some mornings before a shift I can barely manage coffee and a granola bar, and my scrubs are loose… and I’m not trying to lose weight.
